kaikki_vikisozluk.e: بَرْبَرِيّ • (barbariyy) (feminine بَرْبَرِيَّة (barbariyya), masculine plural بَرْبَرِيُّون (barbariyyūn) or بَرَابِرَة (barābira), feminine plural بَرْبَرِيَّات (barbariyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Arabic بَرْبَر (barbar)
Proto-Afroasiatic
Proto-Semitic
Arabic ـِيّ (-iyy)
Arabic بربري
From بَرْبَر (barbar, “Berbers”) + ـِيّ (-iyy), probably from Ancient Greek βάρβαρος (bárbaros, “non-Greek, foreign, barbarian”), apparently imitative of foreign speech.
